Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapons Range
Duration: Instant
Components: W (Any ranged/Thrown), M
Cost: 8 Chakra
Keywords: Bukijutsu
Description: As a requirement for casting this jutsu, you must target a willing creature within 5 feet who knows Advanced Transformation. You coordinate with your ally, as they transform into a weapon of your choice and you launch both them and another weapon at your target, but your ally is hidden in the shadow of your real weapon attack. Make a ranged taijutsu attack at disadvantage, dealing your [Weapons damage] on a hit.
Regardless of a hit or miss, your ally is able to surprise your target. By spending their reaction, your ally can move into a space of their choice, within your weapons range and then make either a weapon attack or cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 action. This attack is made at advantage and the target creature is surprised against this attack.
